error.invalid_contracted_power_periods: Contracted-power assignments are invalid, overlapping, or have an end date before the start date.
error.source_not_found: The selected sensor does not exist. Check the entity and try again.

error.invalid_source_value: The current sensor state is not numeric. Wait for a valid reading or select another sensor.

user.title: Language / Jezik
user.description: Choose the initial language for SI Grid Monitor's own dashboard and reports. Home Assistant's native setup dialogs continue to follow the Home Assistant frontend language.

data_description.preferred_language: English is the default. Change this later in Options or with the accessible EN/SL dashboard switch.

source.title: Meter source
source.description: Recommended: choose signed live grid power when available. Otherwise use separate import/export power or import-only power. V1.0 supports live W/kW sensors only.

data_description.meter_name: A clear name shown on every dashboard page, for example Main Grid, Garage or Workshop.
data_description.source_mode: Choose signed power, separate import/export power, or import-only power.

meter.title: Measurement source
meter.description: Choose the live grid-power sensor fields shown for this source mode. V1.0 accepts W or kW.

data_description.power_entity: Select the grid-connection power sensor (W or kW), not total house consumption or PV production. Current readings will be normalized into import (+) and export (−).
data_description.positive_means_import: Enable if a positive live-power reading means grid import; disable for reversed sensor polarity. Review the preview before continuing.
data_description.import_power_entity: A nonnegative W or kW grid-import reading.
data_description.export_power_entity: A nonnegative W or kW grid-export reading.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure measurement source
reconfigure.description: Choose a supported V1.0 live-power mode. The same configuration entry and SQLite archive are preserved; accepted measurements begin a new source epoch.

data_description.meter_name: The existing meter title may be retained or changed without changing its archive namespace.
data_description.source_mode: Choose one of the three supported live-power modes. Cumulative energy is not accepted in V1.0.

reconfigure_meter.title: Select replacement live-power source
reconfigure_meter.description: Select W/kW entities only. Legacy Mode D counter settings and archived rows remain preserved and are never reinterpreted.

data_description.power_entity: Signed W/kW power at the grid connection.
data_description.positive_means_import: Enable when positive values mean grid import; disable for reversed sensor polarity.

polarity_preview.title: Check normalized source
polarity_preview.description: {preview} Review direction, units, measurement type and unavailable capabilities before continuing.

data_description.confirm: Confirm the preview and proceed. If import appears as export, return to the polarity field; the confirmation does not change sensor data.

contract.title: Contracted-power validity
contract.description: Dates are inclusive local dates. The optional record date and provenance preserve the distributor assignment's audit trail.

data_description.assignment_start_date: First local calendar date on which this contracted-power assignment applies (inclusive). For example, 2026-01-01.
data_description.assignment_end_date: Last local calendar date for these limits (inclusive). The system does not silently extend the assignment into future years.
data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date printed or recorded on the distributor's assignment. This is evidence/provenance, not the start of validity.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Identify who provided these limits, for example 'distributor assignment'. Kept with archived contract metadata.

target_mode.title: Contracted-power mode
target_mode.description: A contracted limit is a 15-minute average import-demand target, not instantaneous breaker or phase capacity.

data_description.target_mode: Use one shared kW limit for B1–B5, or enter five independent limits. These are limits for 15-minute import demand, not electrical breaker capacity.

shared_target.title: Shared B1-B5 target
shared_target.description: This value will be saved for all five tariff blocks in the dated assignment.

data_description.target_kw: Agreed 15-minute average IMPORT power in kW. Shared mode copies this exact limit into all five tariff blocks for the selected dates.

individual_targets.title: Individual B1-B5 targets
individual_targets.description: Enter the distributor-assigned 15-minute contracted power for every block.

data_description.target_b1_kw: Distributor-assigned B1 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B1 applies.
data_description.target_b2_kw: Distributor-assigned B2 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B2 applies.
data_description.target_b3_kw: Distributor-assigned B3 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B3 applies.
data_description.target_b4_kw: Distributor-assigned B4 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B4 applies.
data_description.target_b5_kw: Distributor-assigned B5 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B5 applies.

calculation.title: Calculation settings
calculation.description: Defaults may be submitted unchanged. Provisional 2028-2030 tariff continuation is disabled unless explicitly enabled.

data.allow_provisional_tariff: Allow provisional tariffs for unverified years

data_description.safety_margin_kw: Optional planning buffer (kW) subtracted from the agreed limit when calculating operational headroom. Default 0.00 kW; does not change the contract.
data_description.smoothing_seconds: Averages recent signed power for the end-of-quarter forecast. 30 s reacts faster; 120 s is steadier but slower to follow changes.
data_description.sustained_horizon_minutes: How long (15/30/60/120 min) continuous extra demand is evaluated, including any stricter tariff blocks coming next.
data_description.retention: How long completed 15-minute quarters remain in the integration-owned SQLite database. 'Forever' preserves them across normal HA recorder purges.
data_description.allow_provisional_tariff: Opt in to explicitly provisional continuation of the 2027 block pattern for unverified years 2028–2030. Without opt-in no future block/limit is claimed as confirmed.
data_description.simulation_enabled: Use a temporary comparison threshold without changing the distributor-assigned B1–B5 schedule. Simulated results never count as confirmed contractual statistics.
data_description.simulation_target_kw: Temporary kW threshold used only while simulation is enabled. It does not overwrite dated contracted-power assignments or archived provenance.

data_description.confirm: Confirm the preview and proceed. If import appears as export, return to the polarity field; the confirmation does not change sensor data.

data_publishing.title: Data Publishing
data_publishing.description: Controls Home Assistant state publication without changing one-second calculations, completed-quarter archive data or entity identities. Storage Optimized is the recommended default.

data_description.publishing_profile: Storage Optimized targets the two-meter 1 GB/year engineering budget. Automation Priority publishes selected values faster and may exceed it. Custom uses the controls below.
data_description.publishing_routine_interval_seconds: Maximum cadence for changed monitoring and diagnostic states. Identical states are never written as a heartbeat.
data_description.publishing_actionable_interval_seconds: Normal cadence for changed CAN ADD, MUST REDUCE and forecast values. Zero crossings and critical transitions remain immediate.
data_description.publishing_power_deadband_kw: Minor kW changes below this value are coalesced until another meaningful change occurs.
data_description.publishing_energy_deadband_kwh: Minor kWh changes below this value are coalesced until another meaningful change occurs.
data_description.publishing_actionable_delta_kw: A materially worse MUST REDUCE increase or CAN ADD decrease at or above this kW difference is published on the next evaluation. Safe improvements remain coalesced.
data_description.publishing_actionable_hysteresis_kw: CAN ADD and MUST REDUCE activate immediately only after rising above this kW threshold; clearing to zero remains immediate.
data_description.publishing_fast_entities: Selected entities publish every meaningful value change. Faster third-party automation evaluation increases Recorder and InfluxDB output.

publishing_preview.title: Review publishing impact

data_description.confirm: Confirm after reviewing the current meter-count estimate and automation/storage trade-off.

restore_publishing_defaults.title: Restore recommended publishing defaults
restore_publishing_defaults.description: Restores Storage Optimized publication controls. Calculations, contract schedules, archives and entity identities are unchanged.

archive_removal.title: Archive behavior when this meter is removed
archive_removal.description: Meter: {meter}. Native removal safely keeps its SQLite archive. A permanent-deletion confirmation expires after 10 minutes; remove this exact config entry within that window or the archive is retained.

data.archive_removal_backup: Create a SQLite backup before permanent deletion

data_description.archive_removal_action: Keep preserves the database for manual recovery. Delete permanently removes only this meter's database and owned WAL/SHM sidecars after runtime shutdown.
data_description.archive_removal_backup: Stores a consistent SQLite backup in Home Assistant's .storage/si_grid_monitor_backups folder before deletion.

confirm_archive_deletion.title: Confirm permanent archive deletion
confirm_archive_deletion.description: This cannot be undone from SI Grid Monitor. Type exactly {confirmation}, then remove {meter} within 10 minutes. After that, authorization expires and removal keeps the archive.

data_description.archive_removal_confirmation: This entry-scoped authorization expires after 10 minutes and protects other configured meters and their archives from accidental deletion.

assignments.title: Contracted-power assignments
assignments.description: Choose Edit details, Schedule change, Correct assignment or Remove. Inclusive periods cannot overlap; changes are previewed before saving.

data_description.assignment_action: Choose exactly which dated contract assignment to edit or remove. Editing only that period does not rewrite older completed quarters.

add_assignment.title: Add contracted-power assignment
add_assignment.description: Add an inclusive validity period with five block targets.

data_description.assignment_start_date: First local calendar date on which this contracted-power assignment applies (inclusive). For example, 2026-01-01.
data_description.assignment_end_date: Last local calendar date for these limits (inclusive). The system does not silently extend the assignment into future years.
data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date printed or recorded on the distributor's assignment. This is evidence/provenance, not the start of validity.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Identify who provided these limits, for example 'distributor assignment'. Kept with archived contract metadata.

data_description.target_b2_kw: Distributor-assigned B2 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B2 applies.
data_description.target_b3_kw: Distributor-assigned B3 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B3 applies.
data_description.target_b4_kw: Distributor-assigned B4 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B4 applies.
data_description.target_b5_kw: Distributor-assigned B5 15-minute average IMPORT demand limit in kW. Used only while this dated assignment is valid and B5 applies.

edit_assignment.title: Edit assignment details
edit_assignment.description: Change provenance or the optional record date. Effective dates, B1-B5 values and archived quarters remain unchanged.

data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date printed or recorded on the distributor's assignment. This is evidence/provenance, not the start of validity.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Identify the source of these user-entered limits. This does not independently verify their legal accuracy.

correct_assignment.title: Correct contracted-power assignment
correct_assignment.description: Correct mistaken dates or B1-B5 values. Completed quarters keep their original target evidence; configuration and historical evidence may therefore differ.

data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date shown on the source record.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Source of the corrected user-entered limits.

schedule_change.title: Schedule contract change
schedule_change.description: Enter the first inclusive local date for the new limits. Leave the optional end empty to use the selected assignment's end; setting it creates a safe three-way split.

data_description.assignment_start_date: First inclusive local date for the new limits.
data_description.assignment_change_end_date: Optional final inclusive date; leave empty to use the selected assignment's end.
data_description.assignment_recorded_on: Optional date shown on the source record.
data_description.assignment_provenance: Source of the new user-entered limits.

contract_preview.title: Review contract schedule

data_description.confirm: Confirm only after reviewing every resulting inclusive period and all B1-B5 values.

remove_assignment.title: Remove contracted-power assignment
remove_assignment.description: Confirm removal. Archived measurements and immutable quarter provenance are not deleted.

data_description.confirm: Confirm the preview and proceed. If import appears as export, return to the polarity field; the confirmation does not change sensor data.

legacy_mode_d_unsupported.title: Legacy cumulative-energy meter needs reconfiguration
legacy_mode_d_unsupported.description: {meter} uses Mode D cumulative energy counters, which are not supported in SI Grid Monitor V1.0. Your archived data and configuration have been preserved. Reconfigure this entry with a supported live power sensor using Mode A, B or C.

contract_uncovered_expiry.title: Contracted-power assignment expires without a successor
contract_uncovered_expiry.description: {meter}'s assignment ends on {end}. No assignment starts on the next local calendar day. Add the next assignment to keep contractual forecasts available.

contract_missing_current_assignment.title: No contracted-power assignment covers today
contract_missing_current_assignment.description: No assignment for {meter} covers {date}. Power and energy measurements continue, but contractual comparison and confirmed exceedances are unavailable.

contract_configuration_error.title: Contracted-power schedule is invalid
contract_configuration_error.description: The contracted-power schedule for {meter} cannot be parsed safely. Measurements continue, but contractual advice is unavailable until the configuration is corrected.
